CAMPAIGN LIBRARY

Save / Load.

Pick up where you left off. Your last opened sector or cluster returns after a refresh.

Saved in this browser on this device. Export JSON for a backup or to move a campaign to another device. Clearing site data removes local saves. Open a different map before removing the current one.

CLUSTER MANAGEMENT

Manage Cluster Sectors.

Add, remove, or move sectors and connect them to as many other sectors as you choose. Changes apply to your map when you save.

Select any grid and drag it to move. Arrow keys move the selected grid; Shift moves farther. Overlapping grids cannot be saved.

Selected sector

Choose a saved sector or import a sector JSON.

Connections to other sectors

Check every sector to connect. Set automatic lanes or choose star pairs separately for each. Manual star pairs stay fixed when sectors move.

Sector saves stay separate. Removing a sector here removes only its copy and lanes from this cluster. All placement, connection settings, star pairs, and campaign edits are included in the cluster save.

Your sector, in three dimensions

Import a Sectors Without Number JSON export. Existing X/Y coordinates are retained; missing Z values get repeatable generated heights. Use a system’s dossier to override its height.

Stellar colors follow blue, white, yellow, orange, and red spectral classes. Classes and orbit layouts are generated visual assignments because the source does not specify them; orbital distances and planet sizes are schematic. Select a star, then click or tap it again to enter its system and click any object to inspect it. Click or tap empty map space to clear selection; dragging keeps it selected. The explorer and course planner close when you click or tap outside them. Entering a star zooms into the system; reduced-motion settings skip the animation. Planet settlement density, lighting, terrain tones, and ice coverage reflect population, tech level, and temperature. Settlements have visible daytime structures; TL5 worlds are planet-wide ecumenopolises. Each lane connection adds a bidirectional gate on the system boundary, aligned with the neighboring system in 3D. Gates can be local travel endpoints or used to plot their connected lane.

Interstellar travel has two modes: Drift Lane takes 7 days per system-to-system jump. The Vast uses (jumps × 4)d6 days, based on the shortest equivalent lane path, with a direct route line. Dice counts are calculated automatically. The default sector has no source routes, so its existing map connections form the lane network.

Imported sectors and campaign edits save automatically in this browser. Your last opened sector or cluster returns after a refresh. Use Menu → Save / Load to switch campaigns, import or export sectors and clusters, or reopen the default. Open Factions from the Menu to create factions and assign orbitals, systems, or sectors. Enable Factions on the map toolbar to show territory borders; striped regions are contested by multiple factions. Manage Cluster Sectors lets you add or delete sectors, move any existing grid, and connect each sector to multiple others. Choose one to three automatic edge-star pairs per connected sector or select manual star pairs. Changes are staged until Save cluster changes; Cancel leaves your map unchanged. Drag any selected grid in the manager preview for custom placement, or set its X/Y offsets. Tap empty space inside a sector grid to center the camera on it. Tap empty space outside all sector grids to return to the whole cluster while keeping your viewing angle. Reset view also restores the default angle. The viewer recenters on all sector grids when a new one is added. Save Cluster stores the combined layout; saves are grouped into Clusters and Sectors. Use the sector selector to save a single member separately. Use Import cluster to reopen an exported cluster with its sector placements and connections. Export JSON for backups or to move a sector to another device. The default Aurelian Expanse uses Greco-Roman names. All other SWN generator data is preserved; it is not converted into Starfinder stat blocks.
